intro.title: Welcome to MarkFlowy!
intro.ai_desc: Built-in Copilot, translation, summary, and DeepSeek/ChatGPT and other mainstream models support.
intro.lightweight_desc: Built with Tauri for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Package size varies by platform and installer.
intro.modes_desc: Switch between WYSIWYG and Source Code.
intro.files_desc: Handles Markdown, JSON, TXT, and more.
intro.themes_desc: Design and share your own editor styles.

config.description: A local-first Markdown editor focused on large documents and optional AI.

hero.title: MarkFlowy
hero.subtitle: A local-first Markdown editor focused on large documents and optional AI.
hero.description: A local-first Markdown editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux, focused on large documents and optional AI with cloud providers or local Ollama models.
hero.metaTitle: MarkFlowy — Markdown editing, performance, and optional AI

features.lead: A minimalist yet powerful editor that combines AI intelligence with refined writing experience — built for those who value focus and craft.

feature1.title: Multiple Editing Modes
feature1.description: Supports source code and WYSIWYG editing modes to meet different scenario needs, and supports editing files other than Markdown, such as JSON, TXT, etc.

feature2.title: Built-in AI Assistant
feature2.description: Integrates a powerful AI assistant that supports text generation, conversation, translation, and other functions to improve editing efficiency.

feature3.title: Custom Themes
feature3.description: Provides built-in light and dark themes, and supports custom themes to meet personalized needs.

capability1.title: WYSIWYG & Source Code
capability1.body: Seamlessly switch between What You See Is What You Get and source code modes. Edit Markdown, JSON, TXT and more with full flexibility.

capability2.title: Copilot & Smart Assist
capability2.body: Connect optional AI providers for chat, translation, summaries, and Copilot. Choose cloud services or run a local model with Ollama.

capability3.title: Large-document editing
capability3.body: The v0.100.0 release notes report a 2 MB Markdown file opening in around 1 second in testing. See the test context and limits before comparing results.

capability4.title: Themes & Hotkeys
capability4.body: Design your own editor themes and share them. Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts to match your workflow.

hero.title: Your ideas, in full flow.
hero.lead: A local-first Markdown editor for everything you want to write.
hero.description: Bring your notes, long-form writing, and optional AI together. Your files stay yours.
hero.platforms: Made for the way you work

preview.title: Less between you and your next idea.
preview.description: Your files, editor, and document outline in one window. From quick notes to longer drafts, give your ideas room to grow.
preview.screenshotAlt: MarkFlowy desktop in light mode, showing the file list, Markdown source editor, and document outline

features.title: Everything your writing needs. Nothing in its way.
features.description: From a quick note to a long document, build a writing flow that feels like your own.

write.title: Markdown, the way you think.
write.body: Write visually or get closer to the source. Work with Markdown, JSON, and plain text in one familiar space.
write.alt: MarkFlowy desktop editor displaying a writing sample

local.title: Your words. Your files.
local.body: Work directly with local files in open formats. Organize your workspace and keep large documents within reach.

ai.title: A little help, when you need it.
ai.body: Bring your own AI service for conversations, summaries, and translation, or connect a local model with Ollama.
ai.alt: MarkFlowy desktop editor with its optional AI assistant panel

personal.title: Make yourself at home.
personal.body: Choose your theme, set your shortcuts, and settle into a distraction-free space that works for you.

workflow.title: One space. Your whole writing flow.

capture.title: Catch the thought.
capture.body: Open a local folder and start a note. Ordinary files, ready whenever inspiration arrives.

refine.title: Find the right words.
refine.body: Shape the structure, edit visually, or work in source mode. Bring in AI only when it helps.

share.title: Take it with you.
share.body: Keep the Markdown source or export your work. Your writing belongs wherever you need it.

community.title: Better, together.
community.body: MarkFlowy grows with the people who use it. Read the code, share an idea, report a bug, or help shape what comes next.

cta.title: Your next idea starts here.
cta.body: A little more focus. A lot more flow.

footer.tagline: A local-first space for ideas to become words.
footer.made: Made for the love of writing.
